purpose: Let the running machine deliberately continue from a changed state: re-test and adopt an exact executable-organ candidate into the live organ library, inspect the current evolution surface, create the existing one-per-day whole-machine recovery snapshot, or restore a known-good daily snapshot while quarantining the later body.

properties.path: adopt-organ only; detached spawned organ candidate directory
properties.reason: adopt-organ or restore-machine-snapshot; concrete inspectable reason for the state transition
properties.root_fit: adopt-organ only; explicit current-machine fit decision for Truth, Agency, Continuity, and Wisdom Before Speed
properties.snapshot_output_dir: adopt-organ only; optional explicit directory for the one-per-day pre-mutation recovery snapshot
properties.replace: snapshot-machine only; optional explicit replacement of today's snapshot
properties.snapshot: restore-machine-snapshot only; exact known-good snapshot archive
properties.confirm: restore-machine-snapshot only; must be true because whole-body restore is destructive to the current active state

contains: exact candidate and live-body digests when applicable

relationships: turns detached Forge evidence into a deliberate continuing-machine state transition instead of a permanent outside approval gate
re-runs candidate tests immediately before organ adoption and checks a separate current four-root fit decision
ensures the existing complete daily recovery snapshot before mutating the live organ library
installs and registers an adopted organ by placing its exact tested package in executable-organs/
promotes the adopted organ for normal interface-driven composition as a consequence of successful live-library registration
can invoke the existing daily whole-body restore path, which quarantines the later current state instead of silently deleting it
keeps installation, registration, promotion, merge, CANON, and permission changes distinguishable because they are different evolution operations, not globally forbidden actions

anatomy_refs.basis: Before organ mutation the capability ensures the existing once-per-day whole-machine recovery snapshot, and whole-body restore uses that known-good snapshot while quarantining the later state.
Organ adoption reuses exact detached candidate test evidence and rechecks the installed source digest and live-library registration.

limitations: v0.2 Creation-Unit adoption supports new executable-organ refs only; replacement and in-place organ upgrade semantics remain a later explicit transition
organ candidate tests currently prove executable-organ package structure, not emitted browser or runtime behavior
whole-machine recovery is intentionally daily rather than a per-change event history; several same-day changes may roll back together to the known-good daily snapshot
whole-body candidate merge, CANON change, and permission change are valid evolution directions but are not bundled into organ adoption
there is no global instruction or score to grow continuously; evolution remains driven by concrete capability needs
persistent_state: successful organ adoption changes executable-organs/; recovery uses the existing external daily snapshot archive and quarantine body rather than a new per-adoption history ledger

truth.basis: The capability records which state transition occurred, rechecks exact candidate/source evidence, and does not relabel structural organ validation as runtime proof.

agency.basis: The running machine can choose and perform its own inspectable adoption or recovery transition without requiring a permanent human or outside AI approval gate.

continuity.basis: Live mutation is preceded by the machine's existing daily whole-body snapshot, and restore quarantines the later state instead of destroying it silently.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: Candidate re-test, current root fit, daily recovery readiness, exact write verification, and live-library reload occur around adoption without turning growth into a target.
